reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for reviewable long-term context; the current release provides dynamic context and status inspection while recording only aggregate session metadata in process memory.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供面向长期上下文的 Git 记忆集成，目前支持动态上下文和状态查看，并仅在进程内记录会话事件汇总信息。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness integration for long-term context that currently provides dynamic context and status inspection while recording only aggregate session event data in process memory.

capabilities: Registers dynamic context for DeepSeek Harness sessions
Observes aggregate session event metadata and timestamps
Provides a human-facing memory status command
Provides a read-only memory status model tool
Stores aggregate observations only in process memory
